question: Can the actual ordinary physical-Pencil precision PAN carry source-class metadata through the existing GHOST Trackpad and WM path, without changing packet count/order/data/coalescing or claiming ownership?
answer: Yes, as a narrow source-class bit with explicit constructor defaults, ingestion type checks, conservative all-contributors merge and public synthetic-enqueue clearing. It is sufficient input to consider a separately reviewed denial-only native View2D dispatch policy. It is not accepted-DOWN proof, pairing proof, current contact liveness, a lease, a node tool claim or complete mixed-input coverage.

mixed_source_merge_contract.existing_rule: wm_event_add_trackpad8614-8634 merges adjacent equal event->type with equal TOUCH_PINCH bit, adds previous xy-prev_xy to incoming delta, frees previous packet and enqueues a complete copy of newest event with accumulated prev_xy.
mixed_source_merge_contract.proposed_rule: Keep that exact predicate and arithmetic. Before freeing previous packet, calculate all_source = newest_has_source && previous_has_source; previous_has_source already describes all contributors to its aggregate. After the existing copy, clear only the new bit when all_source is false. No-merge result retains the incoming source bit.
mixed_source_merge_contract.why_not_OR_or_latest: OR falsely marks hardware delta as Pencil; copying newest alone also falsely marks hardware-before-Pencil and loses Pencil-before-hardware provenance. Source equality used to block merging changes baseline counts/coalescing; it is out of scope.
mixed_source_merge_contract.incomplete_coverage: A mixed aggregate intentionally falls back to ordinary native navigation, so its Pencil component may still move the node graph. This source-only design cannot simultaneously preserve existing coalescing and identify the Pencil portion of an unknown aggregate. Report that limitation rather than claim complete protection.
mixed_source_merge_contract.other_metadata: Keep newest event modifiers, tablet, flags other than this bit, and coordinates exactly as current merge. The source class proves neither all-contributor modifiers nor same physical contact. Consumer policy evaluates the actual resulting dispatch and cannot infer either.
